label: Industrial Ingestion — DLQ
info:
Industrial Ingestion — DLQ

Dead-letter publisher for read, validate, publish and uncaught failures
from the Modbus and OPC UA client tabs.

DLQ envelope shape:
  {
    error_type:       'read'|'validate'|'publish'|'uncaught',
    error_message:    string,
    error_timestamp:  ISO 8601,
    source_protocol:  'modbus-tcp'|'opc-ua'|null,
    device_id:        string|null,
    original_envelope: <industrial ingestion envelope>|null
  }

The DLQ producer publishes to the same Kafka cluster as the main path;
its own publish failures are logged to stderr and dropped (non-recursive
catch), mirroring the SFTP ingestion DLQ.

name: FACIS Stackable Kafka Cluster (industrial ingestion DLQ)
format DLQ envelope + metric
